# THE EDGE — trading journal

> THE EDGE (theedgecat.com) is a web trading journal for forex, crypto, indices and prop firm traders. It imports trades automatically from MetaTrader 5, calculates the statistics itself and shows which habits cost the trader money. Available in English and Ukrainian.

THE EDGE is not a signal service and not a trading course. It is record-keeping: the trader writes the plan and the reasons behind trades, and the app calculates results and surfaces repeated mistakes.

## Key facts

- Automatic trade import from MetaTrader 5 via the read-only investor password (it cannot trade or withdraw funds). Works with standard MT5 brokers and prop firms such as FTMO, The5ers, Alpha Capital, Blue Guardian, FundingPips and CryptoFundTrader.
- Statistics: R-multiple, win rate, profit factor, expectancy, drawdown; breakdowns by session (Asia, London, New York), asset, setup, weekday and emotional state.
- Daily plan with a pre-session state check, trade journal, weekly reviews, mistakes log, backtesting, the "20-trade method" discipline exercise, prop account tracking with payouts.
- AI coach that reviews the trader's own trades — in development, not yet released.
- Pricing: Free plan forever. Pro — $15/month or $144/year, 14-day free trial.
- Data is locked to the user's account at the database level; nothing is public unless the user creates a share link. CSV export is always available.
